Typeface for eCommerce

# Give your shoppers a personalized experience

[Contact sales](https://www.typeface.ai/contact-sales)

Refreshing your online shop demands time and effort. By [personalizing your product showcases and content](https://www.typeface.ai/product/brand-hub), your customers find what they want faster, leading to more sales for you.

Product listings

## Onboard products faster to extend full-priced sales

**Write compelling product descriptions** Keep up with the pace of [SEO needs for eCommerce marketing](https://www.typeface.ai/resources/webinars/how-to-use-ai-for-seo-strategy-workflow) by generating more product descriptions that mirror customer feedback and market research, without the manual hassle.

**Enrich your product attribution data** Update and correct product data within your PIM systems from photos or vendor-supplied data to improve accuracy.

![Product Listings_R2.png](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/5uqbxtmPBHair80QQKn0Vb/948ddb502000bba9be5e4328872b76c5/Product_Listings_R2_639d70723d.png)

Visual merchandising

## Showcase products better with lifestyle imagery

**Make targeted shoppable content** Generate stunning, cost-effective visuals tailored to customer preferences and locations with [AI product photography](https://www.typeface.ai/education/typeface-academy/ai-product-photography), reducing the need for expensive photoshoots.

**Tailor web displays and ads** Customize your website’s banners, ads, and articles to attract multiple audiences, boost traffic to your site, and drive more purchases with AI-driven eCommerce content marketing.

![commerce_use_case_visual_merch.png](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/qCV01ajw7SCFxL7j3Cuac/3cbe473dc1c79a9b297406be1265e96b/commerce_use_case_visual_merch_0d2eeb47be.png)

Third-party marketplaces

## Grow your presence across all channels

**Build content fast for third-party marketplaces**

Produce and refresh localized content for leading eCommerce marketplaces like Amazon, Walmart, and more to ensure broader reach with minimal expenses.

**Customize for diverse audiences** Tailor your eCommerce marketing content to resonate with diverse demographics across various third-party distribution channels.

![Third party distribution_R2_A.png](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/68UXw6hCaJUzirD1xmP9E7/e358eef051abeb075f6e588763110cc0/Third_party_distribution_R2_A_db21bb077d.png)

HOW IT WORKS

## Your workflow to turn products into profits

![Use-case-workflow-icon-connect-to-data-product -catalog.svg](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/2bKhlPdEnPF3oLCRZoKGvd/3e6e5f70c69e94ebf87485e1ef9243d9/Use_case_workflow_icon_connect_to_data_product_catalog_4ade778a45.svg)

### Upload your products

Import or link your product catalogs to use your digital assets for on-brand image generation.

![use-case-workflow-icon-brand kit.svg](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/1Qcm8U4vLJwk3OX9GvlbCz/28608d06c80be01e8386e86b0e537b8c/use_case_workflow_icon_brand_kit_592b9e778c.svg)

### Set up your Arc Graph

Define your brand's voice, visual style, and audience segments for consistent and targeted content.

![Use-case-workflow-icon-connect-to-data.svg](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/1XMjSC4b9IdCSmwW40FxHe/ec83a7e7a3af427d6f8913ba8283d24c/Use_case_workflow_icon_connect_to_data_869b145704.svg)

### Connect to your data

Enhance product listings and attributes by integrating your customer data and PIM systems.

![use-case-workflow-icon-templates.svg](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/OAceN816lgDtxZIMskwOW/d91b11d9a443580cb98a2b6cacb7f881/use_case_workflow_icon_templates_fbabb4a9f6.svg)

### Create from templates

Use Typeface's Copilot equipped with templates for drafting engaging product descriptions and visuals.

![Use-case-workflow-icon-connect-to-data-across- channel.svg](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/1VLqQw9f2gYQXT9nCQZx9v/cf1dd21fbde8664c7f2596efad3066b2/Use_case_workflow_icon_connect_to_data_across_channel_39433fe06e.svg)

### Deliver across channels

Create and distribute content across web, social, email, and more to engage audiences everywhere.

CUSTOMER SUCCESS

## Fortune 500 Electronics Brand Supercharges Content Velocity with Typeface

A Fortune 500 electronics brand used AI product photography and editing to quickly [generate custom web display banners for seasonal campaigns](https://www.typeface.ai/blog/how-to-use-ai-image-generators-for-holiday-banners) like Halloween and New Year's, showcasing various product lines across multiple sites—something previously unfeasible due to resource limits.
